text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: How dare you make Kokkoro suffer! You're gonna pay for this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よくもコッコロちゃんを！
　
許しませんよ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Time to sleep with the fishes, you tentacled mutant!
text_block_list.orig_text:
海の藻屑にしてやるから、
覚悟しなさい！

text_block_list.name: Suzume
text_block_list.text:
I'll do everything I can do back you up!
Kokkoro is family to me now.
We can't afford to fail here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
サポートはお任せください！
コッコロちゃんは大切な家族です……
絶対に助けてみせます！
